summary: Drone has no local user name and password form: sign-in is an OAuth hand-off to the Git provider the server is configured with.

sources.title: The catalog profile drone-ci: its description

staysInteractive.note: The whole sign-in: OAuth with the configured Git provider, including that provider's own second factor or security key.

lookedFor: The catalog profile's own description: interactive sign-in through the configured Git provider's OAuth flow; Drone has no universal local user name and password form; runner and API tokens are not browser credentials.
No page of the application was read or captured: by that description it has no form of its own to find, and a self-hosted server is never contacted.
neededFromUser: Nothing turns this into a saved-password login. Say which Git provider your Drone server signs in with: a saved password belongs to that provider's own sign-in page.
